1.

O Jesus, how sweetly our breast is filled At the thought of Thee and Thy name! Yet sweeter it becomes to hear Thy voice And rest in peace in Thy bosom.

2.

No clearest voices, no ringing brass Can give a more beautiful sound, Than when we hear Thy hallowed name, O Saviour of men, God!

3.

To Thee the burdened hearts turn, Thou art the joy of the humble. Thy gentleness toward all who pray we have known, Thy goodness we have experienced here.

4.

Thy love, O Lord, all joy it can give, No tongue can express here, No pen can describe, only they know it, Who belong to Thee, dear Lord.

5.

O Jesus, our eternal joy Thou art, Our victory reward Thou shalt be! May Thou be our glory on the journey here And then in eternity all!
